# 1. Setup & Libraries

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| echo: true
#| eval: true

# renv to ensure consistent package versions across environments 
if (!requireNamespace("renv", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("renv")
if (!file.exists("renv.lock")) renv::init(bare = TRUE)
renv::restore(prompt = FALSE)

# Data Manipulation
library(dplyr)           # >= 1.1.4
library(tidyr)           # >= 1.3.1
library(lubridate)       # >= 1.9.4
library(stringr)         # >= 1.5.1

# Statistics & Modeling
library(brms)            # >= 2.22.0
library(rstan)           # >= 2.32.7
library(cmdstanr)        # >= 0.9.0
library(splines)         # base R
library(performance)     # >= 0.15.0
library(loo)             # >= 2.8.0
library(tidybayes)       # >= 3.0.7
library(ggdist)          # >= 3.3.3
library(emmeans)         # >= 1.11.2
library(bayestestR)      # >= 0.16.1
library(priorsense)      # >= 1.2.0
library(marginaleffects) # >= 0.31.0
library(posterior)       # >= 1.6.1

# Visualization
library(ggplot2)         # >= 4.0.1
library(patchwork)       # >= 1.3.1
library(corrplot)        # >= 0.95
library(ggpubr)          # >= 0.6.1
library(ggforce)         # >= 0.5.0
library(ggrepel)         # >= 0.9.2
library(ggsignif)        # >= 0.6.4

# Reporting
library(flextable)       # >= 0.9.9
library(officer)         # >= 0.6.10

# Global Options
options(mc.cores = max(1, parallel::detectCores()-1))
```
